On-Demand Certification

Primitive Reflex Certification

The Missing Link Between Learning, Behaviour & Nervous System Regulation
Open to all regulated healthcare providers and educators.
Pre-training module plus a two-day intensive, on demand
Live Zoom competency review with Dr. Jenna Davis
Certification on completion
$1,195 USD
Enroll

Primitive reflexes are not just infant responses.

They are foundational neurological programs that shape posture, movement, oral function, regulation and learning. When they don't integrate in sequence, the nervous system works harder than it should. This certification teaches you how to see that.

This is not a reflex drill course. It is a brain-based framework for interpreting reflexes as signals of nervous system dysregulation. Not labels. Not diagnoses. Clues.

What makes this certification different

  • Early observation beginning in infancy
  • The foundational order and sequence of reflex integration
  • Filling gaps in the neurodevelopmental foundation
  • Preventing compensation patterns before they entrench
  • Modifying integration strategies for all ages and abilities
  • Designing individualized, sustainable, brain-based plans families can actually do at home

The experience

A foundational module, then the certification intensive.

Part 1

Pre-Training

On demand

Before the intensive, you complete a foundational module so we begin aligned in language, neurology and clinical thinking.

  • Brainstem development and reflex sequencing
  • Sensory input, motor output, neurological organization
  • Vagal tone and adaptability
  • Why compensation consumes energy
Part 2

Two-Day Certification Intensive

Available in person or on demand

You will learn how to:

  • Assess primitive reflex patterns across the lifespan
  • Recognize how retained reflexes influence learning, speech, oral function, posture, behaviour and regulation
  • Understand the neurological "traffic jams" that create fatigue and compensation
  • Create individualized integration strategies based on age, ability and neurological readiness
  • Modify exercises for infants, toddlers, school-aged children, teens, adults, athletes and those with sensory or regulation challenges
  • Educate parents and educators in a way that increases understanding and compliance
  • Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary model

Certification pathway

Competency-based. On demand, you complete the full intensive plus a live Zoom competency review with Dr. Jenna Davis to ensure clarity and safe application before certification is granted.

This is not passive learning. It is clinical transformation.

Pricing

$1,195 USDEnroll

Who is eligible

Open to chiropractors, dentists, pediatricians, MDs and NPs, osteopaths, physiotherapists, naturopathic doctors, speech-language pathologists, myofunctional therapists, IBCLCs, occupational therapists, educators, therapists and other regulated professionals.

Whether you assess directly or use this knowledge to support and educate families, this certification expands your lens and strengthens your impact.

Taught by

Dr. Jenna Davis

Family chiropractor, international speaker and educator based in Oakville, Ontario, and the creator of the P.I.P.S.™ Technique.

About Dr. Jenna
